abstract: Covers The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3. RFC 8446 The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3 is current; RFC 5246 The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.2 is supported; RFC 9325 Recommendations for Secure Use of Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) is current; RFC 8705 OAuth 2.0 Mutual-TLS Client Authentication and Certificate-Bound Access Tokens is current; TLS Encrypted Client Hello is preview. Requirements are quotes from the pinned text. SKILL.md holds the workflow; references split versions and the quoted requirements.
